headline: Oil prices plunge as US and Iran reach peace deal to end war
summary: The agreement includes reopening the Strait of Hormuz and ending military operations, triggering a global market surge and a drop in oil prices.
details: The United States and Iran have reached a preliminary agreement to end their war, with a formal memorandum of understanding scheduled to be signed this Friday in Switzerland.
US President Donald Trump announced that the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping route for global oil and gas, will reopen on Friday, and the US blockade of Iranian ports will end.
Iran's Supreme National Security Council stated that military operations on all fronts, including Lebanon, would end permanently starting Monday night.
The deal has triggered an immediate impact on global markets, causing oil prices to tumble and stock markets in Asia and elsewhere to surge.
A 60-day ceasefire period will follow, during which a more expansive agreement will be negotiated, including sanctions relief for Iran.
G7 leaders are meeting in Evian-les-Bains, France, to discuss the next steps on Iran and other global issues, including the war in Ukraine and economic imbalances.
The UK, France, Germany, and Italy have expressed readiness to lift sanctions on Iran as part of the peace process.
The US is expected to release $12 billion in frozen assets to Iran, according to Iranian media reports.
caption:
Oil prices crash and markets surge as the US and Iran agree to end their war.

The United States and Iran have reached a preliminary agreement to end their war, with a formal memorandum of understanding scheduled to be signed this Friday in Switzerland.

US President Donald Trump announced that the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping route for global oil and gas, will reopen on Friday, and the US blockade of Iranian ports will end.

Iran's Supreme National Security Council stated that military operations on all fronts, including Lebanon, would end permanently starting Monday night.

The deal has triggered an immediate impact on global markets, causing oil prices to tumble and stock markets in Asia and elsewhere to surge.

A 60-day ceasefire period will follow, during which a more expansive agreement will be negotiated, including sanctions relief for Iran.

G7 leaders are meeting in Evian-les-Bains, France, to discuss the next steps on Iran and other global issues, including the war in Ukraine and economic imbalances.

The UK, France, Germany, and Italy have expressed readiness to lift sanctions on Iran as part of the peace process.

The US is expected to release $12 billion in frozen assets to Iran, according to Iranian media reports.

headline_marked: Suspect [[arrested over murders of mother and daughter]] in Chattogram
headline: Suspect arrested over murders of mother and daughter in Chattogram
summary: A man is in custody following the killing of Annie Barua and her 16-year-old daughter in Anwara Upazila.
details: Police have arrested Tejpriyo Barua, a cousin of the victims' father, in connection with the double murder of a mother and daughter in Chattogram’s Anwara Upazila.
The victims, 40-year-old Annie Barua and 16-year-old Priyanti Barua, were killed at their home in Chenamati Barua Para on Saturday night.
The victims' husband and father, Sujan Barua, claims the attack was motivated by a loan dispute. He believes Tejpriyo entered the house to steal a stamped document regarding a loan of Tk 170,000.
The victims were hacked to death with a sharp weapon. A 5-year-old son of Annie Barua was also injured during the attack.
Chattogram District Assistant Superintendent of Police (Anwara Circle) Mahmudul Hasan confirmed the arrest and stated that further details will be discussed at a press conference.
Sujan Barua works as a security guard in Chattogram city, while his family lived at their village home in Anwara.
caption:
A mother and her 16-year-old daughter were killed at home in Chattogram. A cousin has been arrested as the suspected motive is a loan dispute.

Police have arrested Tejpriyo Barua, a cousin of the victims' father, in connection with the double murder of a mother and daughter in Chattogram’s Anwara Upazila.

The victims, 40-year-old Annie Barua and 16-year-old Priyanti Barua, were killed at their home in Chenamati Barua Para on Saturday night.

The victims' husband and father, Sujan Barua, claims the attack was motivated by a loan dispute. He believes Tejpriyo entered the house to steal a stamped document regarding a loan of Tk 170,000.

The victims were hacked to death with a sharp weapon. A 5-year-old son of Annie Barua was also injured during the attack.

Chattogram District Assistant Superintendent of Police (Anwara Circle) Mahmudul Hasan confirmed the arrest and stated that further details will be discussed at a press conference.

Sujan Barua works as a security guard in Chattogram city, while his family lived at their village home in Anwara.
